messages:
Omar Khan: Heads-up — new intake request: 'sumi-7b' from HF. 7B causal decoder, Apache-2.0. Source: https://huggingface.co/sumi/sumi-7b. Upstream evals show competitive instr-following and smaller footprint than our current 13B configs. Request: triage for quantization viability + a rollout plan (internal beta -> hosted API).

Jess Li: Assigned — I'll own bring-up. Quick questions: do we have any known tile/attention kernels needed? target latency per-token SLO? and preferred quant path (awq/q4/ptq)?

Omar Khan: No special kernels noted by upstream. Target: <20ms p50 for short chat (<=512 tokens) on our A100-40G fleet or equivalent. Prefer AWQ/8-bit-first experiments, fallback to Q4 if AWQ regresses quality.

Anita Patel: License and data lineage checked: Apache-2.0, no known dataset restrictions. Early manual evals show slight tendency to be terse on followups — we should include multi-turn pass rates in evals.

Jess Li: Plan sketch — checklist: 1) Download and validate model artifacts + checksums. 2) Baseline float32 perf and qualitative evals (3 prompt suites). 3) AWQ-8 + Q4 bench (latency, mem, token quality). 4) Regression tests vs. redwood-13b baselines on our eval harness. 5) Model catalog entry + docs PR. 6) Staged beta on Dedicated pool -> hosted canary. 7) Announcement note + client opt-in.

Mike R.: Timeline ask from product: 3 weeks to internal beta would be great. We'll need the catalog entry + release blurb at least 3 business days before canary. I'll coordinate customer beta invites and legal sign-off.

Jess Li: OK timeline acceptable. I'll put up GH issues and a checklist board today. Owners: Jess (ML bring-up), Anita (quality evals), SRE-Lee (monitoring + infra), Mike R. (release/customer comms), docs-bot (docs/cat).

docs-bot: Model catalog template suggestion — use standard fields. Example snippet below:```yaml
name: sumi-7b
source: huggingface/sumi/sumi-7b
size: 7B
license: apache-2.0
architecture: causal-decoder
recommended_quant: awq-8
recommended_instance_types:
  - a100-40g
  - h100-80g
notes: "Early tests: good instruction following; watch for terse multi-turn answers"
```

Jess Li: For benching: I'll run our standard bench script: `./bench/run_perf.py --model sumi-7b --seq 512 --batch 1 --quant awq-8,q4_0` and upload results to the intake ticket.

deploy-bot: Queue check: resource planner estimates ~2 reserved A100-40G slots for initial experiments (quant bake + canary). No quota blocks currently. ETA provisioning: 1 business day once requested.

SRE-Lee: Monitoring checklist: 1) Add per-model latency SLO (p50/p95), 2) Token-cost dashboard, 3) Error rate alerts on OOM/OOB, 4) KV-cache hit rate if we enable prefix-caching. I'll stub dashboards and share links.

Anita Patel: Eval plan: I'll run 3 prompt suites (conversational, code, summarization) + 200 held-out prompts for regression checks vs redwood-13b and onyx-7b (our smaller baseline). We'll compute BLEU/ROUGE-ish where applicable and our human pass-rate scoring.

Jess Li: Quality gates proposal: - Min human pass-rate >= redwood-13b - No >3% increase in hallucination tokens on code suite - Latency p50 <= 20ms on target instance (float or quant) - Memory per-request fits within 40G for Dedicated. If gates fail, we iterate on quant or fall back to a larger variant.

Mike R.: Announcement plan: short internal beta note -> blog/announce only after 2 weeks of beta and metrics stable. I'll draft the beta invite template: include known caveats and opt-in instructions.

Omar Khan: Please keep me posted on any license or export flags; also tag me on the intake ticket for blocking decisions.

Jess Li: Opening tickets now: GH #4521 (sumi-7b intake) with tasks + gantt. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-intake/issues/4521. I'll post status updates here.

docs-bot: Reminder: include model-card JSON in catalog PR with fields: provenance, evals summary, recommended quant configs, cost estimates.

SRE-Lee: Small note: if AWQ reduces memory enough we can run more concurrent streams; I'll add a concurrency test to the bench.

Anita Patel: Starting evals this afternoon. Will post initial qualitative notes and first regression matrix by EOD tomorrow.

Jess Li: Thanks all — next checkpoint: quick sync in 48h unless blockers. ping @Mike R. for release calendar alignment. :thumbsup:

Mike R.: Got it — added to release calendar. I will check legal sign-off by EOD tomorrow.

Omar Khan: Great work, team.
